modes.label: Inside split drug or enzyme names
modes.description: A word that is cut into pieces and the marked piece sits in the middle, mostly in drug, enzyme or disease names.

modes.label: Nouns in protein-structure text
modes.description: A plain noun after a number or modifier in descriptions of protein domains and reaction states.
